segments.caption: A tall, spiral structure made of matchsticks ignites from the top, with flames rapidly spreading downward, consuming the entire structure in a bright, fiery blaze.
A spiral tower of matches ignites and burns intensely, flames rapidly consuming the structure from top to bottom as it stands upright on a surface.

A tall, spiraling tower of matchsticks is engulfed in flames, which rapidly spread and intensify, consuming the structure from top to bottom until it collapses into a glowing, smoldering pile of charred remains.

A small, contained fire burns brightly, its flames dancing and growing more vigorous as it consumes a pile of matchsticks on a reflective surface, casting an orange glow that illuminates the surrounding area.
